components.name: gazetteer/2026-08-25b/candidate.db
components.description: Global admin candidate gazetteer — population-first place resolution + postcode coverage across 244 countries.

properties.name: mailwoman:manifestUnread
properties.value: local copy at /mnt/mw/db/wof/candidate.db is 3050020864 bytes and the published artifact is 2880921600 bytes, so its manifest describes a different build

properties.name: mailwoman:publishers
properties.value: Who's On First | GeoNames | Overture Maps Foundation, for its Divisions theme

properties.name: mailwoman:terms
properties.value: Who's On First: Creative Commons Zero covers the format and structure, in those words, and the dataset is also a modification of existing open data whose sources carry their own terms. The text as retrieved on 2026-09-21 is archived at packages/corpus/data/licenses/whosonfirst-licenses.md. | GeoNames: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, the version its export readme names. Its about page names the license without a version. Both as retrieved on 2026-09-21, archived at packages/corpus/data/licenses/geonames-publication.md. | Overture Maps Divisions: the Open Database License. Overture's attribution page gives its Divisions theme `License for theme: ODbL`, read 2026-09-25. The published artifact's own layer_manifest records `license = ODbL-1.0 AND CDLA-Permissive-2.0 AND CC-BY-4.0` and derives from admin-global-priority@2026-08-25, read over HTTP range requests on 2026-09-27. The admin gazetteer under that name folds Overture Divisions. On the lab host's 2026-09-15 chain, where each fold's synthetic id range makes the rows countable, Overture Divisions contributed 1,590,314 of 4,921,635 admin places, 32.31%, and all 1,590,314 reach that chain's candidate database as 18.25% of its 8,714,235 places.

properties.name: mailwoman:conditions
properties.value: Link back to the Who's On First license. Its own text makes the link required and crediting the project recommended, which is the one place those two differ. | Attribute GeoNames. | Read the Open Database License before redistributing this database or a database derived from it. Its share-alike term is what the unresolved question below is about.

properties.name: mailwoman:unresolved
properties.value: Whether the Open Database License's share-alike term reaches this database and its consumers. The expression on the artifact records ODbL-1.0, and what that requires of a redistributor depends on whether the combination is a Derivative Database, a Collective Database, a Produced Work, or an extraction below the threshold the license sets. That reading is with counsel and this entry states no conclusion about it. | Whether the published 2026-08-25 artifact carries the same Overture share as the 2026-09-15 chain measured above, and which Overture Divisions release reached it. Its manifest names its admin source but not that source's own sources, and the 2026-08-25 admin gazetteer is not published, so answering either needs the 2.88 GB download. | Which Overture record each of those places came from. `fold-overture` writes a concordance under `wd:id` alone and discards the GERS id, so no row here can be traced back to its Overture division. That bears on whether an alteration file is producible. | Which upstream project each row's name came from. Who's On First records a geometry source per record and the corpus adapters read none of it — see docs/engineering/reference/artifact-rights-inventory.mdx. | Whether the Ordnance Survey notice in Who's On First's source list reaches any row in this bundle. The list names Ordnance Survey of Northern Ireland under Open Government Licence v3.0 and Ordnance Survey Ireland under its own portal terms, and names Royal Mail nowhere. | Which of the 102 sources the Who's On First list names contributed to a given record. The list was generated 2020-02-21 and the dataset has moved since, so it is evidence of what contributed up to that date.
